meta.title: Moroccan Henna Ceremonies and Made-to-Measure Outfits | Marakesh Mali Petito
meta.description: For over 30 years, Marakesh Mali Petito has produced fairy-tale Moroccan henna ceremonies in Israel: outfits designed and sewn in-house for the bride, groom and family, royal décor, a home henna package, bar and bat mitzvahs. As seen on Channel 12 and Channel 14. Check your date: +972 53-344-4862.
meta.ogAlt: Bride and groom in embroidered gold outfits on the gilded throne of Marakesh Mali Petito

hero.eyebrow: Fairy-tale henna ceremonies · Made-to-measure outfits · 30+ years
hero.title: A henna out of a fairy tale
hero.text: Every outfit is designed and sewn in our studio, for the bride, the groom and the whole family. We bring the throne, the carpets and the magic; all you have to do is arrive and feel like a queen.

proof.years: years of tradition, joy and magic

blocks.title: Thirty years of henna nights
blocks.text: What began as a deep love for the Moroccan henna became a family studio: outfits Mali designs and sews, pieces imported from Morocco, and a family that walks every bride through it from the first meeting.

blocks.title: The bride walks in and the room rises
blocks.text: The procession, the drums, the henna trays and the zaghroutas. We are there from setup until the moment the henna is placed in her palm.

blocks.title: A small henna, the same magic
blocks.text: For those who would rather celebrate at home or in the garden with close family: the grand sofas, the carpet and the henna bowl come to you.

brides.title: Every couple, its own fairy tale
brides.text: A few of the henna nights we produced recently. Many more in our Instagram highlights.

about.title: Mali Petito
about.p1: Mali has been producing henna ceremonies and Mimounas for more than thirty years and is still moved by every single one. She designs, sews, chooses every bowl and every carpet, and is there on the day itself.
about.p2: By her side are Liel Petito and the family, who dress the guests with patience and joy so everyone feels part of the ceremony.
about.quote: Every event still moves me; it’s a privilege to share in the joy.

why.title: Dear bride, this is how we work

items.title: Years of experience
items.text: Behind the designs is Mali, a Shenkar graduate with more than thirty years in design, sewing and henna ceremonies.

items.title: Personal fit and care
items.text: Each outfit is fitted to your style and figure, down to the smallest detail, so your look feels and looks exactly like you.

items.title: Modest, never plain
items.text: We sewed a collection for brides who dress modestly, so you can feel beautiful, special and regal.

items.title: Pieces chosen in Morocco
items.text: Thrones, gates, market carts and serving pieces we import ourselves, in a collection renewed every year.

items.q: How far ahead should we book?
items.a: Dates go quickly in wedding season, so check yours as soon as you have a venue or a wedding date. Made-to-measure outfits also need time for fittings.
Our studio is in Rishon LeZion and the décor comes to you: to the hall, the events garden or your home. Tell us where the henna is and we’ll confirm on a call.

It depends on the package and the guest count: outfits for the bride and groom, for close family and traditional outfits for the guests. The home party includes 10 kaftans for women and 10 kaftans with tarbouches for men.

items.q: Can I try outfits on at the studio?
items.a: Of course. Book a fitting at the studio, browse the catalogue and choose the outfits together. Send us a message to arrange it.

items.q: What does the home package include?
items.a: An elegant white-and-gold sofa, two matching sofas, a traditional Moroccan carpet and a designed henna bowl. You can add outfits for the couple, the family and the guests, and a cookie display.

items.q: How do we secure a date?
items.a: Send us your event details, receive a tailored quote, and hold the date with a deposit. We’ll agree the deposit amount and payment terms with you on a call.
